## Resolution

This ticket has no remaining implementation scope. fz-5xp.87 delivered the complete runtime-helper domain work in commit `ca10f62f9`: the named Enum helpers and the corresponding Json, Map, and Range private helpers received explicit correlated contracts, obsolete diagnostics goldens were removed, and the library/fixture gates passed.

Those contracts remain useful source-owned semantic documentation. They are not the authority for clause-coverage warnings and are not required to suppress them. Demand-driven coverage and removal of the old whole-contract/source checker are owned by fz-kdt.36.

Close this ticket as superseded by the already-delivered fz-5xp.87 scope. Do not add another commit, warning exception, or activation-derived contract.
title: Runtime helper domains: superseded by fz-5xp.87
